reason: Y isolates the receipts job and gives the full flow (Preview review, Finder rename in Paperwork/Inbox to DATE_Vendor_type.pdf, TextEdit tracker.csv with columns), and describes all four exceptions as what Morgan does, including client-types.txt lookup, duplicate left unrenamed with blank new_filename, UNKNOWN-DATE, and over-500 review needed. X merges the separate email-reply job into the receipts document, omits the Finder rename step and path, and does not name client-types.txt. Both get repetitions/days wrong (2 instead of 4 days, 10 sessions) and Y wrongly says the batch began Oct 16, but X's correctness and usability gaps are larger.
